scope: Original native terrain support for SCC24–28; no new depth acquisition or source-rights/status promotion.

native_review.assessment: The 39 restricted SCC26–28 patches correspond to localized ridges, edges, isolated terrain and nearshore outcrops in original numeric depth and same-survey class grids. These panels do not establish rock type, sounding accuracy, fish presence or artifact-free terrain. Native center comparisons differ slightly from projected polygon edges; no resampling or hand-edited geometry was used.
native_review.scope_note: The 39-panel audit preceded adjacent SCC24/25 support. Final shared calibration retains four SCC26 patches (previously five), while SCC27/28 remain 24/10. The earlier inspected surfaces remain original evidence, not a claim of identical final candidate geometries.

release_decision.scc24_25: Retain existing source status and rights, restrict both calibration and extraction with reviewed positive support, recompute all affected public reaches.
release_decision.scc26_28: Retain physical-only status. The existing 39-patch proof has no currently release-eligible patches: 5 are in unreviewed screen scope; 34 intersect MPAs, including 27 also intersecting security areas. Separate source/rights and spatial review remain necessary.

method: Unchanged seafloor-habitat-v1 formula and constants; production threshold values are recomputed from supported cells. No missing class is treated as smooth depth, and same-survey interpretation is not independent habitat confirmation.

before_after.note: Tighter support changes connected components and shared cutoffs; increased count does not mean new surveyed territory.

scc24_25_native_review.sample_method: All, or uniformly spaced indices sorted by source ID and descending area; numeric diagnostics cover every feature.
scc24_25_native_review.assessment: All 109 SCC24 physical candidates were checked numerically, with 18 deterministically sampled panels visually inspected. Original depth and class grids show connected nearshore ridges/outcrops and localized edges. SCC25 has no remaining extracted candidates. Sampling is not an exhaustive artifact or substrate validation. Private diagnostic images and held geometry are not published.
